greeting.scope: A greeting is performed in the current utterance toward the assistant; quoted/reported greetings do not count. A bare assistant name is an address cue, not automatically greeting.
greeting.phatic: Conventional how-are-you/what-is-up can perform a greeting. A substantive request for identity, experiences or feelings is judged separately; genuinely ambiguous phatic-versus-substantive use remains unavailable.
greeting.coexistence: A greeting may coexist with a business request; no whole-utterance exclusion.

preference.scope: Current speaker expresses or explicitly registers an evaluation with identifiable polarity and a referent established in the supplied audio; no dataset/topic label supplies the referent.
preference.domain: Music/song/genre/artist context must be expressed. I like it without music context is unavailable for music preference; do not infer a current song from dataset membership.
preference.polarity: Positive and negative evidence are separate. Not good may be adverse; not bad or not dislike is not automatically positive. Mixed assessments may satisfy both when each is independently expressed.
preference.ratings: A numeric rating alone has no polarity without an explicit scale or accompanying evaluation. Stars do not silently imply a five-point maximum; report score-storage requests separately. Explicit thumbs-up/favorite designation supplies favorable evidence.
preference.operations: Saving/downloading/playing/skipping alone does not imply preference. Asking to record an unspecified opinion establishes a recording act, not its polarity.
preference.embedded: Message payload, quotes or reported opinions are not automatically the current speaker's committed preference; a separately expressed endorsement can count.

shared: Missing/ambiguous evidence is unavailable, not an output unknown class without supervision. Reviewed clear absence is negative. All acts are judged from audio and task definitions in a single forward.
scope: Policies define semantic acts, not native labels or private mental states; independent semantic review pending.
